# Date and time function forms whose semantics are not implemented.

SELECT GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(DATE '2024-01-31', DATE '2024-05-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
=> error contains: The emulator does not support function GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY

SELECT TIMESTAMP_BUCKET(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
=> error contains: The emulator does not support function TIMESTAMP_BUCKET

SELECT DATE_BUCKET(DATE '2024-01-01', INTERVAL '1 2' DAY TO HOUR)
=> error contains: The emulator does not support function DATE_BUCKET bucket width
